name: Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® Credit Card

localized_names.en: Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® Credit Card

apr.notes: Prime + 12.74% to Prime + 20.74% (APR 19.49% to 27.49% as of 03/31/2026). Penalty APR up to 29.99%.

credit_required.notes: Visa Signature cards typically require good to excellent credit.

rewards.currency_label: Atmos Rewards Points (Alaska Mileage Plan miles)

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 on all other purchases

categories.label: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases
Gas, EV charging, cable, streaming, local transit/rideshare

rewards.redemption_notes: 10% rewards bonus on all points if you have an eligible Bank of America account. No blackout dates on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines flights. Points don't expire on active accounts.

signup_bonus.description: 70,000 bonus points and a $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) after spending $2,500 in purchases within first 90 days. Limited-time online offer.

benefits.title: Annual $99 Companion Fare
benefits.description: $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) each account anniversary after spending $6,000 or more on purchases within the prior anniversary year.

benefits.title: Free Checked Bag + Preferred Boarding
benefits.description: Free checked bag and preferred boarding for you and up to 6 guests on same reservation when paying for Alaska/Hawaiian Airlines flight with card.

benefits.title: 20% Back on Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: 20% back on Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines inflight purchases when paying with card.

benefits.title: $100 Off Alaska Lounge+ Membership
benefits.description: $100 off annual Alaska Lounge+ Membership purchased with card.

benefits.title: 10% Rewards Bonus
benefits.description: 10% rewards bonus on all points earned if you have an eligible Bank of America account.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the U.S.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free checked bag for cardholder and up to 6 guests on same reservation on Alaska/Hawaiian Airlines flights
other: Annual $99 Companion Fare after $6,000 spend per anniversary year

notes: Atmos Rewards is the August 2025 rebrand of Alaska Airlines credit cards. Visa Signature. $95 annual fee. 70K bonus + $99 Companion Fare after $2,500 in 90 days.
